summary: Q1 2026 results just released. EPS $1.71 (+16.3% YoY) beat $1.33 estimate; revenue $2.78B (+4.4% YoY) beat $2.58B estimate. Drivers: Airfreight services revenue $1.03B (higher volumes, firmer yields); customs brokerage & other services $1.15B (entry volumes + tariff-driven pricing); airfreight tonnage +5% YoY. Operating income $294.8M (+11% YoY); op margin 10.6% vs 10%. Non-asset-based model resilient to geopolitical disruption. Next earnings (Q2 2026) expected late July/early August 2026 based on historical cadence.
